The NOW Yearbook 1972
programme.desc: Simon Bates with distant memories of a rich & varied era in music! Ted Heath was PM, Jon Pertwee was Doctor Who and a pigeon & a bunch of bag-pipers had the best selling singles.

programme.title: Clare Grogan's Teenage Kicks!
programme.desc: The 5 years from '77 to '81 was possibly the most exciting & vibrant time to be a teenager & Clare Grogan was there - buying the records, seeing the bands & wearing the t-shirts.

programme.title: New Wave Anthems!
programme.desc: Non-stop punk and new wave the cool kids were listening to in the latter half of the decade - expect skinny jeans, safety pins, guitars and a few snarls.

programme.title: The Sound of The Suburbs! 1977-80
programme.desc: In celebration of one of the most dynamic and diverse periods ever in the singles chart, a show spanning punk, new wave, reggae, ska, mod & electronic.

programme.title: The 1975 POWER Hour with Bam!
programme.desc: 60 minutes of power pop and rock! Earplugs at the ready as we rewind to 1975 with Queen, Springsteen, Average White Band and the Quo.

programme.title: The 5 O'Clock Groovy Zone!
programme.desc: Over-bearded men & leftfield ladies - all with fabulous tunes! These are alternative hits from the west coast, the underground & the counter culture of the 1970s.

programme.title: Suzi Quatro's Wild Ones!
programme.desc: Celebrating pioneers and mavericks from Elvis to Aerosmith. Suzi presents her hand-picked list along with personal stories of the many legendary rock'n'rollers she's encountered.

programme.title: Hellraisers! Sweet vs Slade
programme.desc: Sixty minutes of glorious Glam Rock from the godfathers of the genre - from London we have The Sweet, and from the sunny uplands of Wolverhampton it's Slade.

programme.title: The Greatest Showmen! Top 25
programme.desc: Who were the biggest superstar showoffs of the decade? Well how about Sting, Meat Loaf, Iggy, Freddie, Geldof, Jagger, Rod & Daltrey for starters? But who's our No.1 rock frontman.

programme.title: The Punk & New Wave 25!
programme.desc: He's sung & played bass with many over the years, but fame came as one of the original Sex Pistols in 1976. Glen Matlock picks his 25 punk & new wave favourites.
